note: Norfolk Island, read 2026-10-31. The Norfolk Island Act 1979 (Cth, Compilation No. 21, 11 December 2024), s. 18A, puts the laws of an applied law jurisdiction (New South Wales, and for some services Queensland) in force in Norfolk Island, subject to suspension or amendment by a s. 19A Ordinance (the Norfolk Island Applied Laws Ordinance 2016, compilation of 28 June 2023, read for what it suspends) and yielding to the Island's continued enactments. Majority: NSW's age of majority (Minors (Property and Contracts) Act 1970) is on the NSW legislation site, which answered with a Cloudflare challenge, so it wasn't read, and no Norfolk Island enactment setting it was found among the titles legislation.gov.au lists; majority is null. Work: the Employment Act 1988 (NI), a continued enactment (compilation of 20 September 2022), s. 24, sets no minimum age: it bars employing a person under 15 during compulsory school hours or between 11 p.m. and 6 a.m., and for more than 20 hours in a school week or 40 in another, with apprentices over 14 excepted. Whether NSW's Children and Young Persons (Care and Protection) Act 1998, under which the Office of the Children's Guardian requires an authority to employ children (under 16) in entertainment, exhibition, still photography or modelling, applies in Norfolk Island as an applied law (the 2016 Ordinance amends some of its references, which suggests it does) couldn't be settled without its text, so work is null. Service: Australia has no peacetime conscription; the Defence Act 1903 (Compilation No. 88, 29 September 2026) extends to the external Territories (s. 5A) and makes residents of 18 to 59 liable only when called by proclamation in time of war, approved by both Houses (ss. 59-60); service is none.

sources.title: Office of the Children’s Guardian (NSW): Employing children in acting and modelling (ocg.nsw.gov.au)
sources.said: A child is a performer or model who is under 16 years of age. ... The person responsible for casting and giving directions to the child is required to hold an Authority to employ children.

sources.title: Defence Act 1903 (Cth), Compilation No. 88, 29 September 2026 (legislation.gov.au)
sources.said: This Act extends to the external Territories as if each of those Territories were part of Australia. ... In time of war the Governor-General may, by proclamation, call upon persons specified in section 59 to serve
